run_m4t_eval_cli: run the m4t_eval pipeline via hydra CLI to evaluate multilingual translation tasks across language pairs
run_M4TEval_run: run the M4TEval module run method to evaluate a source-target language pair on a TSV dataset
create_M4TEval_module: create an M4TEval StopesModule instance with M4TEvalModuleConfig to schedule multilingual evaluation jobs on a cluster
run_m4t_eval_async: run the async m4t_eval function to instantiate a launcher and schedule M4TEval jobs for multiple language directories
review_M4TEval_requirements: review the M4TEval requirements method to check cluster resource needs like GPUs, CPUs, and timeout settings
